criteria.text: The participant is ≥ 18 years old (or ≥ the legal age within the country if it is older than 18 years).

source.text: Age ≥ 18 years (or ≥ legal age within the country if it is older than 18 years).

criteria.text: The participant has a histologically confirmed MSI-H or dMMR metastatic or locally advanced solid tumor by local testing or central testing.

source.text: Histologically confirmed MSI-H or dMMR metastatic or locally advanced solid tumor by local testing or central testing.

criteria.text: Tumor tissue (formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded sample) archival block must be available. Participants without archived tumor tissue may enroll by undergoing tumor biopsy before dosing.

source.text: Tumor tissue (formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded sample) archival block must be available. Participants without archived tumor tissue may enroll by undergoing tumor biopsy before dosing.

criteria.text: The participant's disease is measurable as defined by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors Version 1.1 (RECIST 1.1).

source.text: Disease measurable as defined by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors Version 1.1 (RECIST 1.1).

criteria.text: The participant has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance (ECOG) status of 0-1.
The participant has adequate organ function as defined in the protocol.

source.text: Adequate organ function as defined in the protocol.

criteria.text: The participant has a primary central nervous system (CNS) tumor.

source.text: Participants with primary central nervous system (CNS) tumors.

criteria.text: The participant has impaired cardiac function or clinically significant cardiac disease.

source.text: Impaired cardiac function or clinically significant cardiac disease.

criteria.text: The participant had major surgery within 28 days of trial day 1.

source.text: Major surgery within 28 days of trial day 1.

criteria.text: The participant received antitumor therapy (chemotherapy, antibody therapy, molecular targeted therapy, hormonal therapy, or investigational agent) within 21 days of first dose of trial treatment, unless anti-tumor therapy is a therapy with 5 times the half-life being shorter than 21 days (in this case, enrollment may be allowed with washout from prior therapy of < 21 days).

source.text: Antitumor therapy (chemotherapy, antibody therapy, molecular targeted therapy, hormonal therapy, or investigational agent) within 21 days of first dose of trial treatment, unless anti-tumor therapy is a therapy with 5 times the half-life being shorter than 21 days (in this case, enrollment may be allowed with washout from prior therapy of \< 21 days.

criteria.text: The participant received radiation therapy within 28 days of the first dose of trial treatment (or local or focal radiotherapy with palliative intent within 14 days of the first dose).

source.text: Radiation therapy within 28 days of the first dose of trial treatment (or local or focal radiotherapy with palliative intent within 14 days of the first dose).

criteria.text: The participant has gastrointestinal tract disease causing the inability to take per os (PO) medication, malabsorption syndrome, requirement for intravenous (IV) alimentation, or uncontrolled inflammatory gastrointestinal disease (eg, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis).

source.text: Gastrointestinal tract disease causing the inability to take per os (PO) medication, malabsorption syndrome, requirement for intravenous (IV) alimentation, uncontrolled inflammatory gastrointestinal disease (eg, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis).
